title: QS Inventory can approve an instance held for review through the approve door, and the documentation mints a seat key through POST /api/me/keys instead of a Settings › API keys screen that does not exist
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-timeout=120000 apps/tracy-web/test/api-keys-guidance.test.mjs packages/web/tracy-harness/test/inventory-approval.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code, the `# pass`, `# fail`, `# skipped` and `# cancelled` lines and the tests named below.
expect: Exit code 0, 0 failures, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled.

'F-S2-001: the Bruno README mints a seat key through the door, not a screen that does not exist', 'no refusal in the error table sends the caller to that screen' and 'the cowork / internal / api host API reference names the door and not the screen' pass: none of the README, ERROR_DOCS and the three documents buildOpenApi builds says Settings › API keys in any spelling, and each still says POST /api/me/keys.
'F-S8-007: the client has an approve call, and it posts the instance and the hashes it was given' passes: one POST /api/ops/inventory/approve whose body is exactly {instanceId, expectedHashes}.

'F-S8-007: only an instance waiting for review, held by nobody, with read-back hashes can be approved', 'Approve is offered on a row waiting for review and on no other' and 'a row that cannot be approved has a disabled Approve, and pressing it sends nothing' pass: [data-approve] exists only on awaiting_review rows; it is disabled for a reserved row and for hashes that are missing, null, empty, a list or text, and for an empty generation; 0 POSTs.

'F-S8-007: the first press only shows what is approved — the generation and the hashes read back' and 'leaving the review approves nothing' pass: 0 POSTs; [data-review-generation] holds the full generation and one [data-review-hash] per hash.

'F-S8-007: confirming sends one approval for that instance with the hashes shown, and a release is drawn only once re-read' and 'an instance released on an earlier approval of its generation is done too, and says so' pass: exactly 1 POST; the review closes only on released === true; the pools and the instances are each read once more.

'F-S8-007: pressing again while the approval is on its way sends nothing more' and 'a review of the same instance opened again while its approval runs cannot send a second one' pass: 1 POST for three presses in one tick and for a reopened review.

'F-S8-007: a refusal or a dropped request is printed, and nothing is drawn as approved' passes for 401 and 403 with no body, 404 NOT_FOUND, 400 BAD_INSTANCE_ID, 409 HASH_MISMATCH, 409 NOT_AWAITING_REVIEW, 500 with and without a body, a 502 that is not JSON and a rejected fetch: one [data-review-error] alert, the review stays open, the row stays awaiting_review, no retry.

'F-S8-007: a 200 that does not say released: true is not a release' passes for an empty body, broken JSON, null, a list, text, {}, a body with no released, released 'true', 1, null and false, and released true beside a code.

'F-S8-007: a review whose instance was read again with other hashes is not sent — not with the old hashes, not with the new', 'a refusal that lands after another instance was opened is not printed in that review', 'an answer that lands after the review was closed opens nothing and is still reported' and 'an answer that lands after the screen was left reads nothing again' pass: 0 POSTs for a review whose row changed on screen; opened again, the review shows and sends the hashes read last.

'F-S8-007: when the re-read after an approval fails, the old rows stay, marked as not confirmed, with a reload' passes for a 500, an unreadable 200, a wrong shape and dropped reads: [data-unconfirmed] is shown, the row and the 0 / 2 ready count stay, and Reload clears the mark without a second POST.

'F-S8-007: a re-read that got one door and not the other draws neither — no new count beside old rows' passes for new pools beside failed or malformed instances and for new instances beside failed or dropped pools: the count stays 0 / 2 ready with the old row, [data-unconfirmed] names the pool, and the released row's Approve is disabled until Reload reads both.

'F-S8-007: an older re-read that lands after a later one failed does not clear the mark', 'an older re-read that fails after a later one was drawn marks nothing' and 'an older re-read that lands after a later one does not draw over it' pass: the mark follows the pool's latest re-read, and the later read's count and rows stay on screen.

'F-S8-007: a released instance cannot be approved again while its row is still being read', 'after an answer that did not confirm, the same review sends nothing until the row is read again', '[R3] after an answer that did not confirm and a re-read that failed, nothing is sent again until a read shows the row' and '[R3] after a re-read that failed, a Reload that shows the instance changed leaves the old review locked' pass: 1 POST while the re-read is pending and after a re-read that failed ([data-review-confirm] disabled, [data-review-unread] shown, 3 presses send nothing); a second POST only after a read that carried the pool showed the same row; a Reload that shows the row changed leaves [data-review-moved] and still 1 POST.

'F-S8-007: a review is the same build only while the row is approvable with that generation and those hashes', 'after an answer that was not a release, a review the re-read no longer matches cannot be sent again', 'a refusal whose re-read shows the same build leaves the review free to send, and says nothing moved' and 'a Refresh that brings the instance changed locks the review that is open' pass: after HASH_MISMATCH, NOT_AWAITING_REVIEW, a 502, released false or a 500 whose re-read shows other hashes, another generation, another state, another pool, a customer holding it, no row or no hashes, [data-review-confirm] is disabled, [data-review-moved] is shown and 3 more presses send nothing (1 POST).

'F-S8-007: Refresh reads the count and the rows of the open pool together, and draws both or neither', 'opening a pool reads its count with its rows, and draws both or neither', 'a pool whose rows were never read is not drawn as empty' and 'a Refresh without any pool open that fails keeps the list and marks it, with no pool named' pass: every read of the screen is the pools with the open pool's instances; one door failing draws neither and shows [data-unconfirmed]; rows never read are [data-unread], not an empty pool.

'F-S8-007: a Refresh started before an approval lands after its re-read and does not draw over it', 'a Refresh pressed while the re-read after an approval is pending is drawn, and that older re-read is not', 'a Refresh that fails while the re-read after an approval is pending keeps the mark when that re-read is drawn', 'a Refresh after a failed re-read draws the pair and clears the mark; a half one clears nothing' and 'opening a pool again while an older read is pending draws the later read, whichever lands last' pass: reads of every kind share one order, and an older one landing late (whole, half or failed) changes neither the count, the rows nor the mark.

'F-S8-007: [F1] when the pools door fails with a pool open, the whole list is marked, not only that pool' passes for a 500, a dropped request, an unreadable 200 and a 500 that carries a pool list: [data-unconfirmed-list] is shown, [data-unconfirmed-pools] names only the pool that read covered, the old counts and rows stay, and one Reload that reads whole clears both.

'F-S8-007: [F2] a failed re-read of one pool stays marked when another pool is opened and read' and '[F2] an instance stays held when another pool is read, until a read carries its own pool' pass: after the second pool is read whole, [data-unconfirmed-list] is gone and [data-unconfirmed-pools] still names the first pool; [data-review-confirm] of the first pool's instance stays disabled (1 POST after 3 presses) until a Reload reads that pool.

'F-S8-007: [F3] an older read of one pool that fails after a later read of another pool was drawn still marks its pool' and '[F3] an older read of one pool that lands whole after a later read of another pool draws and marks nothing' pass: the late failure marks only the pool the read on screen did not carry, with no list mark; the late whole read changes nothing.

'F-S8-007: [F4] a Reload over two marked pools that reads only one of them clears neither mark' passes: [data-unconfirmed-pools] names both pools after a Reload in which either one fails, no count of that read is drawn, and a Reload that reads both clears the marks.

'F-S8-007: [N3] a Reload pressed while the re-read after an approval is pending is drawn, and that older re-read is not' and '[N3] opening the pool again while the re-read after an approval is pending is drawn, and that older re-read is not' pass for an older re-read that lands whole, half or failed: the later read stays on screen with no mark.

'F-S8-007: an answer the screen cannot draw is not drawn as half of a read, nor as an empty list' and 'a first read the screen cannot draw says the inventory could not be read, not that nothing is stocked' pass for each door answering an empty body, broken JSON, null, a list, a wrong envelope, a null row, a row without key, generation, counts, thresholds, id or state, a duplicate row, a row of another pool, a timer row without a period, and a refusal that carries rows: the old count and rows stay with both marks, and Reload draws the new pair.

'F-S8-007: [P] an answer is read only when every field of every row is what the door declares' passes: for each field of a pool, its thresholds, its counts, the timer row, the timer's last outcome, an instance and a quickstart that may be stocked, poolsAnswer / instancesAnswer / eligibleAnswer answer null when that field is missing or of another type (text for a count, a negative or fractional count, an object for text, a time that is not a date) and read the row for every value the door may send; the table of rules names every field the fixtures carry.

'F-S8-007: [P] a row with a field the screen cannot draw is not drawn — the last read stays, marked' passes for empty counts and thresholds, a count that is text, negative or an object, a threshold that is an object or missing, a pause reason, host, version or revision of another type, a timer row whose error, period, start, outcome or author is of another type, and an instance whose label, error, address, tries, state, holder, health time, updated time or generation is of another type: the screen does not throw, the old count and row stay, nothing is drawn as undefined, NaN or [object Object], both marks show, and Reload draws the new pair. '[P] a whole answer with a timer row is drawn, timer and all' passes.

'F-S8-007: [P] a list of what may be stocked that cannot be drawn offers nothing to stock' passes for an empty body, null, a list that is not a list, a null row, a reason, tag or version that is an object, a row with no word on eligibility, one bad row beside a good one, and a refusal that carries rows: the pools are drawn, and there is no Not stocked yet section and no Stock this button.

'F-S8-007: [P] a refusal is printed as a sentence, whatever its body carries' passes for a detail that is an object or a list, a code that is an object and a host that is an object: the screen stays drawn and the notice is a sentence.

'F-S8-007: the read state applies a read whole or not at all, and clears a mark only with a read that carried it' passes: inventory-read-state's begin/settle/approvalBlock, pressed without the screen.

'F-S2-001: no refusal in the error table sends the caller to that screen' also holds that any guidance naming GET /api/me/keys says the list never has the secret and that a lost secret cannot be read back.
evidence: Issue #795. F-S2-001: bruno/README.md, api-reference/errors.js (KEY_INVALID) and api-reference/spec.js sent the reader to Settings › API keys; no client calls /api/me/keys. F-S8-007: the Inventory screen had the Hold for review switch and no caller of /api/ops/inventory/approve. The two test files on the base commit cb76d6c6d, sources from git archive (795-red-before-fix.tap): red-before-fix: tests=60 pass=2 fail=58 skipped=0 cancelled=0 (F-S2-001 red=5, F-S8-007 red=53, every failure an assertion). On the sources as reviewed before the read state became one module (795-round4-red-on-round3.tap): round4-red-on-round3: tests=60 pass=45 fail=15 skipped=0 cancelled=0 (inventory-failure-coverage red=5: the [F1] to [F4] cases; every failure an assertion). On the sources as reviewed before every field of a row was checked (795-round5-red-on-round4.tap): round5-red-on-round4: tests=60 pass=56 fail=4 skipped=0 cancelled=0 (incomplete-inventory-payload-validation red=4: the [P] cases, and nothing else; every failure an assertion). On the fix (795-green.tap): green: tests=60 pass=60 fail=0 skipped=0 cancelled=0. The logs are in the task's artifact directory, not in the repository.
fence: The guidance pattern over the three documentation sources, and on the Inventory screen: the reviewable() rule, the snapshot of the hashes taken when the review opens, and inventory-read-state: one ReadState changed only by begin/settle/withHold — a read takes its number and its pools when it starts, its answers are checked whole (poolsAnswer, instancesAnswer: one check per field of PoolRow, Policy, Supply, Sweep and InstanceRow, which the compiler counts through Shape<T>) and applied together or not at all, never over a later read; the ledger marks the list and each pool separately, and a pool's mark and the hold on its instance are lifted only by an applied read, started later, that carried that pool's instances; approvalBlock() is the one rule behind both the disabled confirm and the press (sending, settling, or a row that is no longer the build the review shows, by sameReview()); only the door's own released === true counts as done. Mounted with react-dom on jsdom with a fetch fixture: no tracy-web, no PostgreSQL, no same-origin guard or seat check, no real browser; the pools and the instances are still two requests, not one database snapshot; the Storybook play functions were not run.
